# English: Combine data/mapping, histogram, and label layers, matching the construction of the first complete price plot.
# 中文：title 是主标题，subtitle 是补充说明，x/y 是坐标轴名称，caption 是图下的来源说明。
# English: title is the main heading, subtitle adds context, x/y label axes, and caption gives the source below the figure.
# 中文：标签应与实际数据和统计量一致；添加文字不会改变分箱、过滤条件或数值单位。
# English: Labels should match the data and statistic; adding text does not change binning, filtering, or units.
